question: Odd one out: [Bartolomeu Dias], [Vasco da Gama], [Pedro Álvares Cabral], [Hernán Cortés]
explanation: Bartolomeu Dias, Vasco da Gama, and Pedro Álvares Cabral were Portuguese explorers focused on the eastern sea route to India, while Hernán Cortés was a Spanish conquistador who conquered the Aztec Empire.
